## Summary

Describe the change and the compiler stage it affects.

## Implementation

- [ ] Interfaces and implementations are placed in the matching subsystem directories.
- [ ] Unsupported behavior is not presented as implemented.
- [ ] No user-facing foundation APIs were added in C, C++, or Rust.

## Tests

- [ ] Added or updated unit tests.
- [ ] Added source-level regression fixtures where relevant.
- [ ] Ran CMake build and CTest, or explained why they could not be run.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] Updated relevant architecture or language documentation.
- [ ] Considered diagnostics and error recovery.
